subject: Energy
title: Types of Energy Storage
description: Learn Types of Energy Storage in one minute.

hook.text: Energy can be stored as chemical energy (batteries), potential energy (water, gravity), heat, or compressed gas.

buildup.text: Each type has tradeoffs—batteries respond fast but are expensive; pumped hydro is cheap but needs geography.

discovery.text: Storage is measured by power (MW, how fast it delivers) and energy (MWh, how long it lasts)—both matter.

twist.text: A battery can deliver lots of power for a short time or modest power for hours—the design determines the balance.

climax.text: No single technology wins everywhere—the grid needs a portfolio of storage types for different time scales.

punchline.text: Chemical, mechanical, thermal—each stores energy differently.
